story.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里谈巴库一号弯锁死：「确实让我措手不及」，本有望登台
story.summaryZh: 皮亚斯特里开局在一号弯超越勒克莱尔升至第二，并一度顶住维斯塔潘和哈贾尔；第一次安全车重启后被维斯塔潘超越，第二次重启后又遭哈贾尔施压，下一圈防守一号弯时出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区后名次大跌，最终列第14。「上半场非常鼓舞人心，之后就崩了……我得弄清楚锁死是怎么回事，因为它确实让我措手不及。」（来源：Formula 1）
story.originalTitle: ‘Certainly took me by surprise’ – Oscar Piastri reflects on Azerbaijan GP result after mistake
detailZh: 迈凯伦在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上过得十分艰难，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯都没有拿到积分。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里承认，那次可能让他失去阿塞拜疆大奖赛领奖台的锁死「确实让我措手不及」；这一天迈凯伦一分未得。
在环绕巴库历史街区的51圈比赛中，皮亚斯特里前半程表现强势，开局在第一个弯角超越夏尔·勒克莱尔升至第二。
随后这位迈凯伦车手顶住了来势汹汹的马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔，两位红牛车手在比赛初段都展现出强劲速度。
在两次安全车中的第一次期间进站后，皮亚斯特里仍保持第二，但重启时没能守住维斯塔潘，跌至第三。
第二次安全车因第一个弯角发生的一起碰撞而出动，迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯卷入其中；重启时皮亚斯特里再次遭到身后的压力，这次来自哈贾尔。
他起初挡住了这位法国车手，但在下一圈进入一号弯时采取防守路线，结果出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区，名次大幅下滑。
「就是失望。显然，我觉得第一段和比赛前半程非常鼓舞人心，但从那以后就有点崩了。」最终列第14名的皮亚斯特里说。
「锁死的事我需要弄清楚发生了什么，因为它确实让我措手不及。我得去看一看，但最后没拿到成绩，显然非常令人失望。」
皮亚斯特里2026赛季至今过得很艰难，只登上过两次领奖台，最近一次还是5月的迈阿密站；而诺里斯在此前五站比赛中赢了两场。
尽管错失成绩，皮亚斯特里仍对自己在巴库整个周末的表现感到鼓舞，因为他重新回到了车阵前列。
「我觉得等尘埃落定，这个周末会有很多积极的东西。」他说。
「我觉得昨天的排位不错，总体上我感觉舒服多了——也许不是更舒服，而是对我需要怎么驾驭这台车有了更明确的方向。
「积极的方面有很多，只是最后没有积分、没有奖杯，显然会很难受。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: McLaren suffered a difficult Azerbaijan Grand Prix as neither Oscar Piastri or Lando Norris scored points.

Oscar Piastri admits that the lock-up which potentially cost the Australian driver a podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise", on a day where McLaren failed to score a point.
Piastri had enjoyed a strong first half to the 51-lap race around Baku's historic streets, overtaking Charles Leclerc for second through the opening corner.
The McLaren driver then held off the charging Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar as both Red Bull drivers showed strong pace early on.
Piastri maintained second when pitting under the first of two Safety Cars, but at the restart, he was unable to hold Verstappen behind and dropped to third.

A second Safety Car was called after a collision at the opening corner, involving McLaren team mate Lando Norris, and Piastri once again faced pressure from behind at the restart, this time from Hadjar.
Having initially rebuffed the Frenchman, Piastri went defensive into Turn 1 on the following lap, suffering a double lock-up that sent him into the run-off area and down the order.

"Just disappointed. Obviously I think the first stint and the first half of the race was very encouraging and then from there on, it kind of unravelled," said Piastri, who was eventually classified in P14.
"The lock-up I need to understand what happened because it certainly took me by surprise. I need to go and have a look, but obviously very disappointing not to have a result at the end."
Piastri has endured a difficult season so far in 2026, taking just two podiums with the last one coming at Miami in May, while Norris has taken two wins from the previous five races.
Despite missing out on the result, Piastri was encouraged by his performance over the weekend in Baku having been back towards the front of the field.
"I think once the dust settles there will be a lot of positives from this weekend," he said.
"I think Qualifying yesterday was good, I think in general I felt much more comfortable, well maybe not more comfortable but I've had more direction on what I need to do with the car.
"There's plenty of positives it just hurts obviously when you don't have any points or a trophy at the end."

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/certainly-took-me-by-surprise-piastri-reflects-on-azerbaijan-gp-result-after-mistake.6THrL3hQt1nTOMgRqVOfmf

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
